import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem bounded_recurrence_window_endpoint_difference (p q : ℝ) (a : ℕ → ℝ) (h₀ : ∀ n, a (n + 2) - a (n + 1) = a (n + 1) - a n) (h₁ : a 1 = p) (h₂ : a 2 = 9) (h₃ : a 3 = 3 * p - q) (h₄ : a 4 = 3 * p + q) : ∀ M N : ℕ, M ≤ 2009 → N ≤ 2009 → a (M + 1) - a (N + 1) = 4 * ((M : ℝ) - (N : ℝ)) := by
  have hR1 := h₀ 1
  have hR2 := h₀ 2
  norm_num at hR1 hR2
  rw [h₃, h₂, h₁] at hR1
  rw [h₄, h₃, h₂] at hR2
  
  have hp : p = 5 := by
    linarith [hR1, hR2]
  
  have hstep : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 2) = a (n + 1) + 4 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        norm_num [h₁, h₂, hp]
    | succ n ih =>
        have hr := h₀ (n + 1)
        have hnext : a (n + 3) = a (n + 2) + 4 := by
          linarith [hr, ih]
        simpa [Nat.succ_eq_add_one, Nat.add_assoc] using hnext
  
  have hformula : ∀ n : ℕ, a (n + 1) = 4 * (n : ℝ) + 5 := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
        norm_num [h₁, hp]
    | succ n ih =>
        have hs := hstep n
        calc
          a (Nat.succ n + 1) = a (n + 2) := by
            congr 1 <;> omega
          _ = a (n + 1) + 4 := by
            simpa [Nat.add_assoc] using hs
          _ = 4 * (Nat.succ n : ℝ) + 5 := by
            rw [ih]
            norm_num [Nat.cast_succ]
            ring
  
  intro M N _ _
  rw [hformula M, hformula N]
  norm_num [Nat.cast_add]
  ring
